# Copilot Instructions

## Repository purpose

This repository contains a GitHub Skills exercise about scaling institutional knowledge with Copilot Spaces. Keep changes focused on the exercise content, documentation, and supporting GitHub configuration.

## Content guidelines

- Prefer clear, concise Markdown with short sections and descriptive headings.
- Preserve the existing learning flow and learner-facing tone when editing exercise content.
- Use relative links for files within this repository.
- Keep examples platform-neutral unless the surrounding lesson requires a specific GitHub feature.
- Do not add generated files, build output, secrets, or personal environment settings.

## Change guidelines

- Make the smallest change that satisfies the request.
- Preserve existing formatting and naming conventions.
- Update nearby documentation when a change makes existing instructions inaccurate.
- Before finishing, check changed Markdown links and review the rendered structure for broken headings, lists, or code fences.

## Response guidelines

When proposing or making a change, briefly state what changed and identify any validation that was performed. Call out assumptions when the repository does not provide enough context.
